text:
Maya: Heads-up — finished the postmortem for the token-ingest lag from 3/14. Action items: token backfill, ledger patch, and invoice corrections. Need owners + SLA commitments. TLDR below.

Kevin: Can we scope the backfill size and timeline? How many accounts affected?

Maya: Rough estimates: ~6k accounts, ~2.7B tokens missing from the ledger last week. Backfill will be batched to avoid spike. I'd like a target: credits and ledger patch within 10 business days.

Sara: From ingest: AJ and I can run the backfill job but we need a safe maintenance window. Expect 4 windows ~2h each. Also we need a small dedupe hotfix to avoid duplicate ingests.

AJ: I can own the backfill run. Prep ETA: 7 days (tests + infra config), run ETA: ~2 days across windows, validation 1 day. So 10 business days is tight — need dev days for the dedupe patch (3 dev days).

Linda: Finance: we need per-account token deltas to calculate credits. Export format required: CSV with columns [account_id, delta_tokens, credit_amount, invoice_id]. Also need clear audit trail and approval signoff for enterprise invoice reissues.

Ramon: Devex can add a small harness to validate a random sample of 100 accounts post-backfill. Will wire it into the runbook.

ops-bot: SRE alert — scheduled maintenance: rolling jobs <job-123> on 2024-03-22 03:00 UTC. Recommend avoiding overlapping heavy backfill tasks during that slot.

Maya: Proposed owners: AJ (backfill run), Sara (validation), Linda (credit issuance + reconciliation), Ramon (test harness + monitors), Kevin (QA + deployment approval). Can everyone ack their pieces?

Kevin: Ack for QA gating. I'll add QA checkpoints to the release board and define pass/fail criteria.

AJ: Ack, but requesting a 72-hr code freeze window pre-run to reduce churn risk.

Linda: Ack — finance needs final CSV at least 48 hrs before issuing automated credits. For enterprise customers we'll likely do manual invoice adjustments.

Sara: Ack — I'll schedule the maintenance windows Mon/Tue off-peak and share times.

Maya: AJ — can you create a short runbook with rollback steps and validation checklist? Put it in docs and link here.

AJ: Yes. Will create runbook: /docs/backfills/token-backfill-runbook.md. It will include pre-checks, run commands, verification queries, and rollback instructions. Will ping when draft is up.

Maya: Product asked whether we should auto-credit affected customers or do a manual process for enterprise. Linda?

Linda: We can do automated credits if the CSV passes validation. For high-value enterprise accounts we should do manual invoice reissues (audit reasons). Also finance will need to document tax/timing impacts.

Sara: Also request: add a monitor that detects token count deltas > X% per account and alerts #eng-oncall. We should catch recurrence early.

Ramon: I'll add a monitoring rule and include a sample run in the runbook. Will link the monitor playbook.

Maya: Recap timeline: prep + dedupe patch — 3 business days; runbook + QA — 4 business days; run across 4 windows next week; validation + finance credits completed within 10 business days total. If anyone hits blockers, escalate to @ceo.

Kevin: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate QA gating and smoke tests.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for infra change at 2024-03-20 22:00 UTC — watch for conflicts.

Maya: Thanks. I'll update the postmortem action tracker with owners, deadlines, and Asana tasks. Next sync: Friday 10:00 PT.

Linda: One more: document if any credits will force invoice reissues (tax implications). Finance needs a list of accounts that cross billing thresholds.

AJ: Noted. Creating runbook now, will ping this thread with draft and checklist.

Maya: Closing note — please add any additional risks to the action tracker (race conditions, rate limits, ledger reconciliation edge cases).

Kevin: Added a QA risk item: token dedupe edge-case where late-arriving fragments could double-count. We'll add a test to reproduce.

Sara: Will schedule a pre-run dry run on a small subset to verify.

Linda: Finance will prepare a credit template and email copy for outreach.

Ramon: Draft monitor + harness PR will be up by EOD tomorrow.

Maya: Great. Thanks everyone.
